values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead, same day included. A 1-night stay can be booked within 3 days of arrival; the Beach Loop sites (2-30) have a 2-night minimum all season and the 1-night exception excludes them in peak season. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away before re-registering.
